pylons_vi: 3 tháp chữ V hình cánh chim (hai lưỡi tháp nghiêng ra ngoài), tháp giữa cao hơn ≈10 m, cao ≈95–105 m
pylons_en: 3 V-shaped 'dove wing' pylons (two outward-leaning blades each), centre pylon ≈10 m taller, ≈95–105 m above water

model3d.notes: Spans 120 + 270 + 270 + 120 m, 35 m concrete box girder (Báo Đấu thầu, Dân Việt, TEDI). 'Cánh chim Hòa bình' V pylons from the TEDI renders (CTC_1–3) and the 2025 ground-breaking render; one pier per pylon with two diverging blade cages (Soha / VTC photos 11/2026). Heights 70 / 80 / 70 m above deck (centre ≈10 m taller; press 102–107 m total), deck ≈25 m above water, 13 stays per side per plane and the 3 m crest are estimated from the renders.

pylon_custom.description: Dove-wing V pylon: two separate blades rise from one low pile cap and lean outward about 12°, curving slightly and flicking outward near the tip. In elevation each blade is a slender band (≈4.5 m wide, ≈3 m at the blunt top) flaring to ≈10 m at the waterline. Seen along the deck, each blade is a wide wing (≈10 m at deck level) tapering to a pointed tip. Stays anchor between ≈0.4 and 0.8 of the height; the top ≈20% is bare. A curved 'bird body' beam joins the blades under the deck; nothing above it. The centre pylon is about 10 m taller.

notes: Round 2 (2026-11-27): redesigned from the official spans and the TEDI 'Cánh chim Hòa bình' renders; see research/model-review/brief-round2-thuong-cat.md. Round 2b (2026-11-27): blade proportions corrected per research/model-review/feedback-round2.md (slender band in elevation flaring below the deck, wide wing across the bridge, low pile cap, curved under-deck beam, 13 stays). Round 3: blades slimmed along the bridge (flare 10 → 4.5 m, blade 4.5 → 3 m, beam 4.5 m) and a stronger outward flick at the tips (feedback-round3.md). Round 5: the pile cap uses the new pylon_custom.pile_cap (same 24 × 24 × 4 m block, now plain concrete).
